info.name: Git Integration
info.description:
Git Integration brings external Git repositories into Nextcloud, providing seamless synchronization, documentation management, and release note generation.
Features: - Connect GitLab accounts (GitLab.com and self-hosted) - Browse and link repositories to Nextcloud folders - Bidirectional synchronization with conflict detection - Markdown and AsciiDoc documentation viewer - Documentation suggestion and approval workflow - Commit history and branch management - Automated release note generation from Git commits - Activity tracking and notifications
Future support planned for Gitea and Forgejo.
